name: PKWiU — Classification of Products and Services
description: Validates BOQ items against the PKWiU (Polska Klasyfikacja Wyrobow i Uslug) classification used in Polish public procurement and VAT determination. Checks that construction works items carry a valid PKWiU section F (Budownictwo) code, that the code format matches the PKWiU hierarchy, and that the VAT rate applied is consistent with the PKWiU classification (8% for residential construction services under certain conditions, 23% standard).
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
